rootCause.summary: Firebase CLI aborts function deployment in non-interactive mode when orphaned functions exist in the project
rootCause.errorMessage:
The following functions are found in your project but do not exist in your local source code:
	api:setAdminClaimOnUserCreate(us-central1)
	api:syncAdminClaimsOnMetadataChange(us-central1)

Aborting because deletion cannot proceed in non-interactive mode.
rootCause.explanation: These functions were previously deployed but have since been removed from the codebase. Firebase CLI requires explicit deletion or --force flag to proceed.
rootCause.relatedToVerifyAttributesMetaNote: The Verify Attributes Meta failure (run 20709996154) is a separate repo-wide Firestore registry_version mismatch issue. It does NOT cause this deployment failure.

proposedFix.approach: Add --force flag to firebase deploy --only functions command in deploy-staging.yml
proposedFix.alternative: Manually delete orphaned functions via 'firebase functions:delete setAdminClaimOnUserCreate syncAdminClaimsOnMetadataChange --region us-central1 --project ropi-bccee'

investigativeSteps: 1. Fetched run 20710169974 metadata — confirmed failure in deploy-staging job
2. Retrieved failing step logs — identified 'Deploy to stable staging site' step 13 as failing
3. Parsed error message — Firebase CLI aborting due to orphaned functions
4. Verified functions not in source code — grep confirms setAdminClaimOnUserCreate/syncAdminClaimsOnMetadataChange removed from codebase
5. Identified fix — add --force flag to allow Firebase CLI to delete orphaned functions

expectedFilesToChange.reason: Add --force flag to firebase deploy functions command

accessConfirmation.credentials: GCP_SA_KEY_BASE64 secret present in staging environment
